sentences.en: You had better combine your work with your family life.
sentences.zh: 你最好把工作和家庭生活结合起来。

sentences.en: The wind and rain combined to make a terrible storm.
sentences.zh: 风和雨结合在一起，形成了可怕的暴风雨。

sentences.en: Today's modern tractors and combines are equipped with high technology.
sentences.zh: 今天的现代化拖拉机和联合收割机配备了高科技。

senses.zh: 使结合，兼有，融合，联结，收割，混合谷物

mnemonic: 词根记忆：com（共同）+bin（两个）+ e→使两个在一起→结合
